structures.overall_structure: grayscale micrograph showing large grains traversed by thick, irregular dark bands (cracks)

characterization_methods.technique: training-free microstructure segmentation via MatSAM (SAM-based visual large model); raw input is a grayscale micrograph
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: no manual annotations; image not provided with corresponding annotations
characterization_methods.purpose: extract crack regions from the IN939-2 micrograph
characterization_methods.key_findings: crack regions are reasonably recognized and clearly separated; the key-structure binary output renders the dark crack bands as white foreground on black

unmapped_findings: IN939-2 (cracks) is one of six additional extended-experiment micrographs (NBS-3 γ' phase, NBS-3 TCP phase, IN939-1 melted pool boundary, IN939-2 cracks, C22000 and C21000 brass twin grain) used to demonstrate MatSAM's extensibility; these image samples are not provided with corresponding annotations.
